verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated test environment with test credentials for exercising the full integration before going live (adyen-docs-6, adyen-docs-18). The agent-facing surfaces are split the same way: the MCP server runs with `--env=TEST` versus `--env=LIVE`, and the Product Feed API has separate test and live base URLs, so AI-driven work can target the sandbox rather than production. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that test data is isolated from live data, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the sandbox experience.
